uncertain: Left-side callout diagrams draw the first signal (D0_1/P0.13 etc.) at the top pin, but the board silkscreen puts 13/15/30 at the bottom pin and GND at the top; physical order follows the silkscreen and the callout names were matched by number (P0.13 to 13, etc.).
Grove I2C SCL callout is printed 'P0.0' with a stray '4' drawn below it overlapping 'P0.05'; recorded as printed 'P0.0' (silkscreen shows 4); the intended name may be P0.04.
3V3 and GND positions come from the board silkscreen only; the callout diagrams do not name them.

Board identity: the image is the same artwork used for the Wio Tracker 1110 Dev Board and shows only a bare board (WM1110-A module); nothing in the image names the Meshtastic kit or shows kit contents.
notes: Labels are the yellow port names (P0.xx) from the callouts; silkscreen number first in functions, then silkscreen/callout signal names. BAT JST connector, antennas, buttons and LEDs skipped. Same image as the Wio Tracker 1110 Dev Board record; read once and applied to both.
